title: Explorer address resolution
responsibility: Resolves an explorer address to the exact stored branch and revision or an explicit missing result.

inputs.name: explorerScope.location
inputs.description: Requested branch, optional selected commit and screen address.

outputs.name: explorerScope
outputs.description: Resolved scope with current/commit mode, branch tip, viewed commit, at-tip flag, first parent and summary. Returns a missing message for an unknown branch, unstored tip or commit, or a commit not recorded on the requested branch; never substitutes a different revision.
